{{Quote|The plague's spiraling out of control. The rakghouls are getting stronger. The virus isn't just infecting sentients anymore. It's spreading through the local wildlife. My patrols have no idea how to handle it.|[[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Byzal]]|<ref name="KUS" />}}
During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the exiled [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Sannus Lorrick]] caused an '''outbreak''' of the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]] in the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]]. A number of worlds were overtaken by the plague before quarantine measures were instituted, and the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kaon]] was the fifth world to be overtaken by [[rakghoul]]s. A [[mission to Kaon]], undertaken by both Republic and Imperial agents, helped [[Mission to the Lost Island|track back]] the plague to Lorrick's [[Lost Island|laboratory]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], where he was [[Death/Legends|killed]], but not before the passenger liner ''[[Stardream]]'' was infected by Lorrick's efforts; the liner crashed on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and caused a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy-wide]] [[Rakghoul pandemic|crisis]].<ref name="Tion Hegemony Rep" /><ref name="Tion Hegemony Imp" />
{{Stub}}
